entries.zh: 相遇；彼此相逢、会面。
entries.en: to meet one another, encounter; to come together.

entries.zh: 逢着；遇到、碰上。
entries.en: to meet with, come upon; to encounter.

entries.zh: 会面、当面相见；汉栏「相病」字义难合，释义以西语栏为主。
entries.en: to meet face to face, to meet in (someone's) presence; Chinese equivalent doubtful.
entries.notes: 西语栏 presencion 疑为 presencia 之 17 世纪拼式，「相病」(sio-pēnn) 与之贴合有限，释义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 相背；意见相左、彼此相悖。
entries.en: to be at variance with one another; to disagree in opinions, take contrary views.

entries.zh: 遇上恶友、撞见仇家（依西语栏）；汉栏「遇着字星」字形存疑、难以对读；〔原件污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to run into a bad friend, an enemy (per the Spanish column); Chinese column characters doubtful; entry uncertain.
entries.notes: 汉栏带 [疑:字/孚]、M 栏第 2 音节 T99 污损，四栏无法互证，释义依西语栏「遇恶友」推定。

entries.zh: 撞上官府、遭官差拿办受害（依西语栏）；汉栏「鈀路」及音写难解；〔原件污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to run into the (officers of) justice, so that they do him harm; to fall afoul of the law (per the Spanish column; Chinese column doubtful).
entries.notes: 汉栏「鈀路」与 M 栏音写（第 4 音节 T99）均难解，释义依西语栏「撞上官法受害」推定。

entries.zh: 触犯；冒犯、得罪（触怒他人）。
entries.en: to offend, affront (someone); to violate, transgress against.
entries.notes: 汉栏「纪」依 M 栏 hūan 与 R 栏 fān 推定为「犯」（触犯）；西语栏缩写 Sto（Sto.＝Santo？）展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 触发；触发、引动、激起（事端）。
entries.en: to trigger, provoke; to stir up, set off.
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写 Sto（Sto.＝Santo？）的展开依赖推断，其与「触发」的对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 触着；碰到、撞上（相触）。
entries.en: to bump into, run into; to touch upon, come into contact with.

entries.zh: 触人目；刺眼、碍眼（触犯众目），亦即惹人注目。
entries.en: to offend the eye, be an eyesore; to catch people's eye.
entries.notes: 西语栏「遇死者及随后骸骨」疑为示例语，与「触人目」贴合牵强，故降为中置信。

entries.zh: 衝撞；互相冲撞、争吵相犯。
entries.en: to clash and quarrel with one another; to collide, run afoul of one another.
entries.notes: 西语栏末词 fozia 难解（或为 fosa「沟坑」、bozería「喧嚷」之讹），不影响主释义。

entries.zh: 遭伊手；遭他毒手、落在他手上（遭其加害）。
entries.en: to fall into his hands, suffer harm at his hands; to be waylaid and hurt.

entries.zh: 遭逢；遭遇到、不期而逢。
entries.en: to encounter, meet with (by chance); to come upon.

entries.zh: 遭遇；遭逢、碰上（多指遭逢不测）。
entries.en: to encounter, meet with (often misfortune); to run into.

entries.zh: 奇遇；奇异的际遇、难得的相逢。
entries.en: a remarkable, serendipitous encounter; to meet by strange fortune.

entries.zh: 奇逢；奇特的相逢、不寻常的际遇。
entries.en: a rare, remarkable meeting; to meet by happy chance.

entries.zh: 邂逅；不期而遇、偶然相逢。
entries.en: a chance encounter; to meet unexpectedly, come upon by accident.

entries.zh: 遇頭；路上相逢、碰头会面。
entries.en: to meet on the way, on the road; to run into (someone) along the way.

entries.zh: 撞頭；路上撞见、迎面相撞。
entries.en: to run into (someone) on the road; to collide, bump head-on.

entries.zh: 仇讎；仇敌、冤家（于赌博、争吵中结仇）。
entries.en: enemy, foe; enmity (formed in gambling or quarrels).

entries.zh: 適遇；恰巧遇见、适逢其会。
entries.en: to happen to meet; to meet by chance or opportunity.

entries.zh: 適然；恰巧如此、适逢其然（偶然恰合）。
entries.en: as it happens, by chance; naturally so.
